headlines.title: U.S. strikes Iran for first time in weeks
headlines.description: A U.S. official tells NBC News that U.S. forces struck two Iranian launchers that were preparing to put sea mines into the Strait of Hormuz today, marking the first attacks of the Iran war in weeks. NBC News’ Yamiche Alcindor reports.

headlines.title: More than a dozen people feared missing in Grand Canyon flash floods
headlines.description: More than a dozen people are feared missing after powerful flash floods swept through the Grand Canyon, the National Park Service said Sunday. One hiker recounts being airlifted from the campground after the floodwaters forced dozens of people to evacuate. NBC News’ Dana Griffin has the latest.

headlines.title: Here’s the biggest news you missed this weekend
headlines.description: Authorities in Nepal have warned of further flooding after heavy rainfall, as China sheds more light on the scale of the disaster in its Tibet region.

headlines.title: Desperate search for Nepal flood survivors enters critical new phase
headlines.description: The desperate, all-out search for survivors after deadly floods hit Nepal entered a critical new phase on Sunday. Our team on the ground spoke with a Massachusetts man who just arrived there to look for his wife. NBC News’ Janis Mackey Frayer reports.

headlines.title: NBC Crew, Palestinian Woman Attacked by Masked Israeli Settlers
headlines.description: NBC’s Matt Bradley joins Sunday TODAY’s Willie Geist to share an update after he, along with members of our news crew and a Palestinian woman, were attacked by settlers in the Israeli-occupied West Bank. Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu accused the settlers of breaking the law and damaging Israel’s standing the world. Warning: The incident was disturbing.

headlines.title: Witness video of Madison police killing raises questions of why lethal force was used
headlines.description: Local authorities said that the matter is being investigated and that the officers involved have been placed on administrative leave.

headlines.title: At least 1 dead, over a dozen missing at Grand Canyon after extreme flash flooding
headlines.description: Authorities are searching for hikers and campers who may have been trapped in the area.

headlines.title: Dolly Parton’s niece shares emotional tribute after singer’s private funeral
headlines.description: The country star’s funeral Friday was a private affair attended by family members, said her niece Lainey Parton.

headlines.title: New Mexico man accused of fatally shooting cousin after argument over enchiladas
headlines.description: Police say the men had been drinking and arguing before a fistfight broke out. A witness said the victim was walking away when Ervin Gutierrez pulled a gun and opened fire.

headlines.title: College football player dies after collapsing on sideline moments after scoring touchdown
headlines.description: William Jewell College in Missouri didn’t disclose the nature of junior running back MicahJo Barnett’s medical emergency.

headlines.title: Rep. Jim Clyburn says impeaching Trump shouldn’t be Democrats’ priority if they win back the House
headlines.description: The South Carolina representative also told “Meet the Press” that he regretted his support for Clarence Thomas during his Supreme Court confirmation hearings in 1991.
